description: SEPForecast estimates energetic-proton event probability and possible peak intensity following solar activity. Its event relationships were derived from a historical solar-cycle analysis and support threshold-based risk alerts. The resource is documented by Royal Belgian Institute for Space Aeronomy (BIRA-IASB). The documented physical domain is Heliosphere / Inner Heliosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Continuous/RT Run (SEP Scoreboard Probability), Continuous/RT Run (ISWA data tree). A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. Forecasts use the observations available at alert time and can change as eruption information improves. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
